text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, some time after becoming Satono Diamond's Trainer, it happened out of nowhere—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I hereby appoint you as the "Vice Leader" of the "Campus Flower Abundance Campaign"—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, were you not aware?
Um, the Campus Flower Abundance Campaign is...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Just as the name says, it's an annual community service project where volunteers gather to plant and decorate the campus with flowers!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was chosen to be the leader this year!♪
It comes with great responsibility!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To ensure its success, I need a calm, attentive vice leader...
In other words—Trainer! I need you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yay! Let's make the entire academy look splendidly gorgeous so everyone can enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: First, we can hang colorful flower baskets... and build a biotope in the courtyard... Ah, the possibilities are endless!
choice_data_list: That sounds pretty ambitious, doesn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you think so?
I was using the Satono estate's Western-style gardens as a reference, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, we might not have enough hands.
Hmm... Is there any other good idea...
choice_data_list: Why don't we walk around the campus for inspiration?
Why don't we walk around the campus for inspiration?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Looking around like this, there are quite a few places lacking flowers...
Shall we take a look inside the school building next...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah! My apologies, someone was already here—!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, *sniff*...! I-I'm fine...
*hic*... Excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...She ran off...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Students troubled by worries often come here.
To sort through their feelings alone...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I know... If there were flowers here...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Vice Leader, what do you think?!
How about placing planter boxes right here?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Flowers offer a gentle, quiet presence to any troubled heart.
So I'm sure they would bring comfort!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it! Even if I do say so myself, it's a wonderful idea.
...Hehe, this feels somewhat like that time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes... When my parents and McQueen-san officially acknowledged us—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The single most important thing for the two of us... is making our dream come true.
Not today's trial.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is why we have devoted ourselves purely to "what is necessary right now."
Even if this is not to your liking...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's just like back then... What is "necessary right now" for this volunteer project isn't extravagance, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Bringing joy and comfort to everyone...!
Thanks to you, I've realized what is truly important once again.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Vice Leader! Let us draft the meeting proposal right away!
If we combine our efforts, we can surely create a wonderful plan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, working right up until the dorm curfew, we finished the proposal.
The following day—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—And that concludes this year's proposal for new activities!
What do you all think...?

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: I'm all for it~! I think it's fantastic~!

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Totally! As expected of Dia-san!
To put together such a thorough plan all on your own...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, it wasn't by my power alone.
It's all thanks to my Trainer helping me out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They stayed late at the library to assist me yesterday.
Gathering materials and summarizing everything so quickly and precisely...!

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Dia-san, you're so straightforward... or rather, bold! Most people would hesitate to ask an adult for that much help~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...? Is that how it normally is...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond murmured in bewilderment.
Ever sincere and innocent, the concept didn't seem to click with her at all.
